meta.base: Ember India subnational electricity release, jk-includes-ladakh
meta.note: Emissions and intensity are estimated lifecycle greenhouse gases expressed as CO2-equivalent. The state release excludes captive generation that national estimates include. Historical renewable capacity can contain upstream imputation; cell-level imputation flags are unavailable. Earlier Ladakh and Jammu-and-Kashmir reporting combines jurisdictions. Complete original release, including India Total and Others. Generation is at plant location, not electricity consumed by residents. Capacity is installed MW, generation is GWh. Emissions/intensity are source estimates. Clean includes nuclear; Renewable excludes nuclear. Aggregate fuel rows overlap individual fuels; do not add both. Source blanks remain null; all-empty series stay in raw and the catalogue with a reason. Geographic instrument: jk-includes-ladakh. July 2021 is the first separate Ladakh monthly observation; annual 2021 is isolated as a mixed reporting-scope transition. No canonical history crosses this boundary.

meta.base: Ember India subnational electricity release, jk-includes-ladakh
meta.note: Emissions and intensity are estimated lifecycle greenhouse gases expressed as CO2-equivalent. The state release excludes captive generation that national estimates include. Historical renewable capacity can contain upstream imputation; cell-level imputation flags are unavailable. Earlier Ladakh and Jammu-and-Kashmir reporting combines jurisdictions. Complete original release, including India Total and Others. Generation is at plant location, not electricity consumed by residents. Capacity is installed MW, generation is GWh. Emissions/intensity are source estimates. Clean includes nuclear; Renewable excludes nuclear. Aggregate fuel rows overlap individual fuels; do not add both. Source blanks remain null; all-empty series stay in raw and the catalogue with a reason. Geographic instrument: jk-includes-ladakh. July 2021 is the first separate Ladakh monthly observation; annual 2021 is isolated as a mixed reporting-scope transition. No canonical history crosses this boundary.
